description: This file implements a custom XML-RPC transport class 'PipXmlrpcTransport' that integrates with the pip package manager's network session. It provides methods to perform XML-RPC requests over HTTP, utilizing pip's session management and error handling.

classes.name: PipXmlrpcTransport
classes.description: A subclass of xmlrpc.client.Transport that uses a PipSession and custom logic to perform network requests for XML-RPC calls, tailored for pip's internal use.

methods.name: None __init__( self, index_url: str, session: PipSession, use_datetime: bool = False )
methods.description: Initializes the PipXmlrpcTransport with an index URL, a PipSession object, and an optional use_datetime flag. Parses the URL to extract the scheme.

methods.name: Tuple["_Marshallable",...] request( self, host: "_HostType", handler: str, request_body: "SizedBuffer", verbose: bool = False, )
methods.description: Constructs the URL and headers, performs a POST request using the pip session, validates the response, and parses the XML response. Handles network connection errors.
